description_expanded:
Escape the crowds while staying close to everything 30A offers. This peaceful Highland Parks home is designed for families who appreciate space, quiet nights, and easy beach access, without the stress of beachfront congestion. Welcome to Veni Vidi Beachy, the place to rest, relax, and enjoy the best of 30A, while avoiding the chaos. Bike to Gulfplace, beaches, enjoy the resort-style, seasonally heated community pool and truly relax in a calm and safe neighborhood setting. 📍 BEACH ACCESS: Three convenient Public Beach Access points. - Blue Mountain Beach Access (.9 of a mile, 4-minute golf cart or bike ride) - Gulfview Heights Beach Access (1.2 miles, 5-minute golf cart or bike ride) - Ed Walline Beach Access (1.6 miles, 6-minute golf cart or bike ride) Walk, bike, or cart to avoid the beach parking hassle (it’s real). 🏖️ BEACH WAGON WITH 4 BEACH CHAIRS 🌳 POINT WASHINGTON STATE PARK: Explore miles of beautiful hiking/biking nature trails in the adjoining Point Washington State Forest. This Florida, State treasure is directly attached to the Highland Parks community, a short walk from your front door. 👙 SEASONALLY HEATED RESORT STYLE POOL: Enjoy our huge, resort style pool, surrounded by beautiful palms.

Amenities include covered pavilion, barbecue grills, hot tub, restrooms on site, and table & chairs to comfortably accommodate your entire family. ✨ CHECKOUT THESE VIEWS: The unique four-story Observation Tower located in the pool area. Take in the breathtaking views for miles around, including a rare view out over the Gulf. 🛌 4 BEDROOM, 4 ½ BATH: Designed as a second home by the owners, and is therefore furnished accordingly, rather than as a typical “rental”. a. Gourmet kitchen, including stainless appliances, quality cookware, multiple sets of dishes & glassware (including martini), two coffee makers, and that all important wine fridge with dual zone cooling. b. 5 Flat screen, smart TV’s , including one in every bedroom, and a 75” BIG SCREEN in the living area. c. Two primary bedrooms with King Beds, and ensuite bath, including dual vanities, a large soaking tub, and luxe multi-head shower. These spacious bedrooms are furnished with elegant, coastal vibe, antique furniture that is truly one of a kind. Each primary bedroom has its own private veranda to enjoy your morning coffee. d. 1 bedroom with Queen bed, furnished with gorgeous, coastal vibe, antique furniture. Also, includes private ensuite bath with dual vanity. e. Kids fun bunkroom with two sets of bunkbeds (single over double, sleeps 3) & private, ensuite bath with dual vanity. This bedroom also offers a private veranda. ⛲️ FAMILY TIME: Enjoy your own private firepit and party lights in the backyard, sitting under the lovely cypress, enjoying the serene lily pond & water fountain. A memorable place for those ends of the day family gatherings. 🍤 GRILL: Webber gas grill at your disposal. 🛺 GOLF CART: Complimentary 6-seater golf cart (woohoo). 🚲 BIKES: Complimentary 6 bicycles. 🥅 GAME ROOM: Professional-grade foosball table for those rainy days, although we hope you don’t need it! 🔥 PRIVATE FIRE PIT: Enjoy the beautiful lagoon from your back patio, sitting around your own private fire pit. 🪞 CHIC COASTAL VIBE: Stunning interiors, meticulously fashioned by an acclaimed designer 🚘 VROOM VROOM: Complimentary Porsche convertible. JUST KIDDING! This is a fabulous house, even without the Porsche! 🦞 DINING: 5-star restaurants 🛍️ SHOPPING: Just a short drive to a plethora of wonderful shopping. Veni Vidi Beachy by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024
